core_obligations: Unfold the construction of the localized classes on both sides: the blowing ups b and b' from More on Flatness, Lemma labelled flat-lemma-complex-and-divisor-blowup-pre, the complexes Q and Q' as derived twists, and the base change square with Q' = (q o g)^*Q (proof lines 10841-10866).

Recall the class P_p(Z -> X, E) = P'_p(Q) with its closed subscheme T', the independence of the choice of T', and the description of the restriction to X' via Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-localized-chern-pre (proof lines 10868-10895).
Conclude with P'_p(Q') = P'_p(q^*Q) from the second part of Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre-independent and identify the two classes (proof lines 10897-10903).
proof_roadmap: Set up the two blowing ups and the derived twists (proof lines 10841-10866).
Recall the construction of P_p(Z -> X, E) and the role of T' (proof lines 10868-10886).
Identify the restriction with the class built from q^*Q (proof lines 10888-10895).
Use independence to match the two constructions (proof lines 10897-10903).
difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-loc-chern, for a morphism f : X' -> X locally of finite type with E' = f^*E and Z' = f^{-1}(Z), the lemma states that the class P_p(Z' -> X', E'), resp. c_p(Z' -> X', E'), constructed as in Lemma labelled lemma-independent-loc-chern from the base changed data is the restriction, in the sense of Remark labelled remark-restriction-bivariant, of P_p(Z -> X, E), resp. c_p(Z -> X, E) (statement lines 10823-10839). The proof unfolds the construction: b : W -> P^1_X and b' : W' -> P^1_{X'} come from More on Flatness, Lemma labelled flat-lemma-complex-and-divisor-blowup-pre applied to the triples (P^1_X, (P^1_X)_infinity, p^*E) and its base change, Q and Q' are the derived twist L eta of the pulled back perfect objects along the ideals of W_infinity and W'_infinity, and the base change lemma of More on Flatness, Lemma labelled flat-lemma-complex-and-divisor-blowup-base-change supplies a commutative square whose morphism g identifies W' with the strict transform and gives Q' = (q o g)^*Q (proof lines 10841-10866). It then recalls that P_p(Z -> X, E) = P'_p(Q) is built from b, Q and a closed subscheme T' of W_infinity with the two properties (a) and (b), that the precise choice of T' is immaterial by Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre-independent, and that Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-localized-chern-pre exhibits the restriction of P'_p(Q) to X' as the class constructed from the base changed blowing up r, the complex q^*Q and the inverse image q^{-1}(T') (proof lines 10868-10895). The second statement of Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre-independent gives P'_p(Q') = P'_p(q^*Q), and the identification P_p(Z' -> X', E') = P'_p(Q') closes the proof (proof lines 10897-10903). Seeing that the two constructions of the base changed class agree, and that the choice of T' does not matter, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
